Results.ReviewText:
I finally upgraded from a cheap grill that needed to be replaced every other year or so, to the Spirit II.  It is the smallest Weber grill.  I grill whenever I want the grill taste, summer, winter, spring and fall.  My grill lives in a covered gazebo like place, so I can grill through the rain that defines Western Oregon. 
The Spirit ll has wonderful heavy duty grill plates that clean easily.  I like the temperature guide in the hood of the grill and the controls are easy to use and read.  This grill offers temperature control, an even heat, and protection from flare-ups.  So far, I am wishing that I should have upgraded years ago.
Results.Title: The best small grill around

Results.ReviewText: I've been a Weber Kettle charcoal griller for over 25 years.  I recently purchased the Spirit E-210 gas grill.  Thankfully I purchased it assembled so I didn't have to deal with putting it together.  I took the removable contents out and my teenage son and I could easily carry the grill up 2 flights of stairs to my townhouse balcony.  I strongly recommend purchasing the perforated box that holds the wood chips.  I always use Mesquite chips when grilling and the flavor is very close to what I get with charcoal.  I will use my charcoal grill for special occasions like grilling a turkey or rib roast, but for every day use the Spirit E-210 is my go-to.  The price was right ($375 assembled) and the size is perfect for my townhouse balcony.  The biggest factor in the purchase was the 10 year warranty.  You can't beat that!!  I also like the ability to easily control the grilling temperature, and the grill surface is large enough that I can do most things on the indirect setting which helps cook things thoroughly without excess char.  The only thing it lacks is the side burner for sauces etc. but since I'm used to cooking with the charcoal kettle, that does not really pose a problem for me.  The models that had the side burner were 2-3 times the cost of this unit.  No question a 5 star rating on this model.
Results.Title: Love it!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
